    Contaminant concentrations in common sole

    soles_contam.Rd

    Biological characteristics and contaminant concentrations measured in common sole (Solea solea) collected during the CHOPIN project in the Seine estuary.

    Format

    A tibble with 74 rows and 215 variables. A row represents a pooled sample, a whole fish, or a tissue/body compartment depending on sample_type. Variables include:

    year

    Numeric. Sampling year.

    date

    POSIXct. Sampling date in UTC.

    season

    Character. Sampling season, with values "spring" and "autumn".

    zone

    Character. Sampling area within the Seine estuary, including "Chenal", "Embouchure", "Fosse Nord", and "Fosse Sud".

    species

    Character. Fish species. All observations correspond to common sole, Solea solea.

    class

    Character. Fish age class: "G0", "G1", or "G2".

    cohort

    Numeric. Year-class of the fish, corresponding to its year of birth.

    sample_type

    Factor. Type of biological sample. Levels are "pool" for pooled fish, "WB" for whole-body samples, "gonads" for gonadal tissue, "liver" for liver tissue, and "rest" for the remaining body compartment after liver and gonads were removed.

    sample_TAG

    Character. Sample identifier used in the CHOPIN project. For G2 fish, the same identifier may occur several times because different tissues from the same individual were analysed separately.

    sex

    Character. Sex code recorded for the sampled fish ("F", "M", or "I").

    length_TL_cm

    Numeric. Total fish length, expressed in centimetres. For pooled samples, values represent the mean length of individuals in the pool.

    length_TL_cm_sd

    Numeric. Standard deviation of total length within pooled samples. Missing for individually analysed fish.

    length_SL_cm

    Numeric. Standard fish length, expressed in centimetres.

    mass_tot_gww

    Numeric. Total fish wet mass, expressed in grams wet weight (g ww). For pooled samples, values represent the mean individual mass.

    mass_tot_gww_sd

    Numeric. Standard deviation of total wet mass within pooled samples. Missing for individually analysed fish.

    dry_content_percent

    Numeric. Dry matter content expressed as a percentage of wet mass.

    lip_dw_percent

    Numeric. Lipid content expressed as a percentage of dry weight.

    delta13C

    Numeric. Carbon stable isotope composition, expressed as delta-13-C values.

    delta15N

    Numeric. Nitrogen stable isotope composition, expressed as delta-15-N values.

    mass_tissue_gww

    Numeric. Wet mass of the analysed tissue or body compartment, expressed in grams wet weight (g ww). Mainly used for G2 tissue samples.

    mass_gdw

    Numeric. Dry mass of the analysed sample or tissue, expressed in grams dry weight (g dw).

    SI

    Numeric. Index variable retained in the original dataset. Values are missing in the current version of the dataset.

    a.HBCDD_pg_gdw, b.HBCDD_pg_gdw, g.HBCDD_pg_gdw

    Numeric. Concentrations of alpha-, beta-, and gamma-HBCDD, respectively, expressed in pg per g dry weight (pg g^-1 dw).

    _ng_gdw

    Numeric. Concentration of an individual PCB congener, PFAS compound, or HBCDD isomer, expressed in ng per g dry weight (ng g^-1 dw).

    a.HBCDD_ng_gdw_censored, b.HBCDD_ng_gdw_censored, g.HBCDD_ng_gdw_censored

    Numeric. HBCDD concentrations prepared for statistical analyses of censored observations.

    _ng_glw

    Numeric. Lipid-normalized concentration of an individual PCB congener or HBCDD isomer, expressed in ng per g lipid weight (ng g^-1 lw).

    _ng

    Numeric. Total amount of an individual contaminant in the analysed sample, fish, or tissue, expressed in ng. These values combine dry-weight contaminant concentration with the dry mass of the corresponding biological sample.

    a.HBCDD_ng_censored, b.HBCDD_ng_censored, g.HBCDD_ng_censored

    Numeric. Total amounts of HBCDD isomers prepared for analyses involving censored observations.

    sumPCB_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of PCB congener concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumHBCDD_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of alpha-, beta-, and gamma-HBCDD concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumHBCDD_ng_gdw_censored

    Numeric. Sum of HBCDD concentrations based on the variables prepared for censored-data analyses.

    sumPFAS_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of PFAS concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumPFCA_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of perfluoroalkyl carboxylic acid (PFCA) concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumFOSA_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of FOSA-related compound concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumPFSA_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of perfluoroalkyl sulfonate (PFSA) concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    _normalised_sum_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Relative contribution of an individual compound to the corresponding contaminant-family sum, calculated from dry-weight concentrations. Values are proportions and therefore dimensionless despite the historical variable suffix.

    _normalised_sum_ng_gdw_censored

    Numeric. Relative contribution of an HBCDD isomer to total HBCDD, calculated using concentrations prepared for censored-data analyses.

    Source

    CHOPIN project common sole sampling and contaminant analytical dataset.

    Details

    The dataset includes fish from three age classes (G0, G1, and G2). G0 fish were analysed as pooled samples, G1 fish were analysed as whole-body samples, and G2 fish were analysed by tissue or body compartment, including liver, gonads, and the remaining body tissues.

    Contaminant measurements include PCBs, PFASs, and HBCDD isomers. Concentrations are provided on a dry-weight basis and, for selected hydrophobic contaminants, on a lipid-weight basis. The dataset also includes contaminant burdens, summed concentrations by chemical family, and the relative contribution of individual compounds to family sums.

    The structure of the dataset differs among age classes. G0 samples are pools of juvenile soles, whereas G1 samples correspond to individual whole fish. For G2 fish, contaminant concentrations were measured separately in the liver, gonads, and remaining body compartment. Thus, several rows can refer to different tissues from the same G2 individual.

    Morphometric variables associated with pooled samples represent mean individual values, with their corresponding standard deviations when available. Morphometric information is repeated across tissue-specific rows belonging to the same G2 individual.

    Individual contaminant identifiers follow the nomenclature provided in contam_info. Concentration variables ending in _ng_gdw are expressed on a dry-weight basis, whereas variables ending in _ng_glw are normalized to lipid content.

    HBCDD concentrations were initially available in pg g^-1 dry weight and are also provided after conversion to ng g^-1 dry weight. Specific variables are retained for analyses accounting for censored HBCDD observations.

    Variables ending in _ng represent contaminant amounts rather than concentrations. They can therefore be used to reconstruct contaminant burdens across the different tissues of G2 fish.

    Variables containing normalised_sum represent the proportional contribution of each compound to the summed concentration of its contaminant family and should not be interpreted as concentrations.

    Zero values in contaminant variables are retained as provided in the analytical dataset and should not automatically be interpreted as true absence without considering analytical detection and quantification limits.
